onboarding.welcome_art: A couple seen from behind, cuddled on a sofa in front of a sunset.
onboarding.welcome_text: Phases follows her cycle and gives you a heads-up the day before the moments that matter.

notif.ovulation_body: The phase when energy and wanting to go out are often at their highest.
